name: Aceituna (Spain)
description: White field with a green bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aceituna (an olive branch on white).
history: The arms and the flag of Aceituna were approved by the Order of 3 June 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 17 June 1993, after their approval by the municipal council on 1 April 1992.
